about_the_game:
The world is left in ruins, slice through the realms above.

Corruption has enraptured everything, bringing madness upon the inhabitants. You must uncover the hidden abilities of your magical sword companion to staunch the bleeding of the world.

Game Features

  • A dual narrative. Experience the past in order to fight for the future.

  • Hand animated lethal boss fights, combat, and exploration.

  • Discover your playstyle through hot-swapping between weapon forms at any time.

  • Meet NPCs and fight creatures and contraptions throughout the world.

  • Hidden secrets and upgrades unlocked through keen observation and trials.

  • Easy to pick up, hard to master. Each weapon form has special interactions within the world.

Currently being worked on day and night by the Lantern Jump team!!!

content_descriptors.notes: Goldstained contains pixel art fantasy violence without over-the-top blood and gore.

short_description: Explore a dangerous, fantastical world and slay the divine being that corrupted it. Goldstained is a top-down 2D action-adventure where unlocking new weapons with new movesets is your way forward through boss fights, puzzles, and combat!
